panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover in a dark stone vault. A giant brass vault ring glows behind. Above it hovers {{glitch}}, grinning, as torn paper scraps swirl. Exactly two kids stand at the bottom looking up, determined: {{theo}}; {{maya}}. {{vex}} floats above them. The top quarter is plain dark stone.
panels.alt: Under the library, the scribbly teal glitch hovers over a giant brass vault ring as torn recipe cards swirl. Andre and Keiko stand below, determined, with VEX floating above them.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide establishing panel at night: an old stone library with glowing arched windows. In the lower foreground, seen from behind, stand exactly four small kids side by side in a blue hoodie, an orange shirt, a red jacket and a green sweatshirt. {{vex}} floats in the upper right. The upper left is plain night sky.
panels.alt: At night, Andre, Mateo, Keiko and Layla stand together in front of Vexhall Library, its windows glowing, while VEX floats high to the right.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of a rainy city street at night where a row of blank street signs are dissolving into teal chalk scribbles. Far down the street, a stone library glows. The top half is plain dark sky.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Dramatic splash panel inside an old library archive room with tall wooden card cabinets, drawers hanging open. Hundreds of torn paper card scraps swirl through the air. In the upper right, {{glitch}} tears a blank card in half, cackling. At the lower left {{dev}} gapes in shock, and at the right {{zara}} clutches her head. A blank brass plaque hangs on a cabinet at the top left.
panels.alt: In the library archive, card cabinet drawers hang open and torn recipe cards swirl everywhere. The glitch rips a card in half, cackling, while Mateo gapes and Layla clutches her head.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of {{vex}} on the right, shining a thin cyan beam straight down through wooden floorboards toward a faint glow below. The left two thirds are plain dark wood.
panels.alt: VEX shines a cyan beam down through the floorboards toward the vault hidden below.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Panel inside {{vault}}. {{ring}} is set into a brass door in the upper center. At the lower left {{theo}} holds up a spool of teal ribbon with a small blank paper tag. At the lower right {{dev}} rubs his chin, grinning. Warm lantern light.

panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Wide panel of {{vex}} on the right, projecting three glowing cyan bars stacked in a column, each bar sliced into four equal pieces. The left half is plain dark stone.
